scope: Post-selection analysis of previously inspected R2 data; accepted Sweeper public API output joins frozen P8 numeric evidence by exact date.
calendar: SPY observed session ordering inherited from the accepted complete 1930-row replay; adjacent eligible session indices only. Weekends/holidays are not missing sessions. A missing eligible row breaks pairs.
duration_censoring: First/last observed runs and runs at missing/gap edges are censored. Observed durations are lower bounds for censored runs; uncensored summaries are also reported.
risk_context_caveat: Trailing realized volatility and input-feature distributions describe contemporaneous context. They are endogenous and are neither future outcomes nor independent evidence of predictive utility.

headline_scope: ALL for Groweer baseline; F3_TEST is separately reported and reconciled to the original P8 headline.

metric_definitions.turnover: changes / consecutive eligible session pairs; observed SPY calendar adjacency; gaps break pairs
metric_definitions.runs: contiguous eligible sessions; report left/right censored runs and both observed/all and uncensored duration summaries
metric_definitions.flip_flop: A-B-A where middle run lasts <= k sessions; k=1,2,3,5; event counted once per middle run, divided by adjacent eligible pairs; k=2 reproduces P8 headline
metric_definitions.one_two_day_states: counts of observed runs of length one/two, not fractions of unrelated calendar days
metric_definitions.distance_to_threshold: signed raw distance in native units for all atomic C03 comparisons, before and after each change
metric_definitions.marginal: descriptive only: changed continuous predicate within 5% of its threshold magnitude, integer predicate within one count, separately counted. This annotation is not a new runtime band.
metric_definitions.speed: elapsed eligible sessions between named qualitative pillar/economic conditions; no subtraction of ordinal labels
metric_definitions.risk_context: contemporaneous/trailing input distributions only, endogenous descriptors; not independent predictive utility

interpretation: A short run or quick reversal is a descriptive instability measure, not evidence that the observation was noisy.
Broad/selective labels encode participation and leadership. Similar trailing realized volatility is not a failed discrimination test of that intended distinction.
Pillar transition counts include changes on days when the final regime remains unchanged; they measure a different object from regime turnover.
Every ordered regime pair is treated nominally. Direct risk-on/defensive/stress jumps are counted without inventing ordinal distances.
